svg.title: Projectile trajectory with landing inset
svg.desc: At 10 pixels per meter, the projectile reaches its apex at 30 meters and 11.25 meters high, then lands at 60 meters after 3 seconds. The landing coordinate x=700 is outside the canvas and appears in a same-scale inset.

g.text: Projectile: vₓ = 20 m/s, vᵧ = 15 m/s, g = 10 m/s²
Scale: 10 px/m. Total flight time: 3 s.
